findings.shape: Eight long narrow heteropolar frustules radiate from enlarged foot-pole attachment cues. Separate paired silica walls and selected golden plastid bodies replace a thick opaque star.
findings.surface: Thin separate silica walls, unequal foot/head-pole outlines and selected golden intracellular cues replace a thick opaque star. Photographic background organisms are excluded from the species model.
findings.movement: The entire retained colony changes position/orientation mildly as an external drift illustration. Individual cells do not swim or rotate independently; no flow solver.
evidenceScope: Selected diagnostic text: slender heteropolar capitate cells and foot-pole mucilage colonies; nonmotile. Source-labelled Mosbo6 live star micrograph compared; field-width label is not model calibration.
corrections: Moved the inner foot poles together after the first detail render showed disconnected arms.
Retained a fixed colony during mild external drift rather than independently swimming cells.
findings.residual: The eight-arm arrangement and inner attachment cluster remain too regular and partly overlap. Intracellular bodies are idealized, fine striae and mucilage ultrastructure are incomplete, and natural silica/illumination optics and dimensions are unmeasured. The low side/front views are inherently edge-on; drift is authored.
